props.name: variant
props.description:
Which layout the timeline draws. Omitted or `default`: a flat sequence of steps or events with dot, number or icon markers.
`company`: roles grouped under a company logo, for résumé and pipeline histories.

props.name: items
props.description:
The entries, in order. Their shape follows `variant`: in the default layout, steps or events (`TimelineItem`).
In the `company` layout, companies with their roles (`TimelineCompany`).

props.name: numbered
props.description: Number the markers 1..n instead of dots

props.name: locale
props.description: The BCP 47 locale the marker numbers are written in, such as `ar-EG`. Defaults to `en-US`. Timeline can render from a Server Component, so it takes the prop alone and reads no LocaleProvider.

props.name: presentLabel
props.description: Text shown in place of the end date for a role marked `present`

TimelineCompany.description: A company/tool entry grouping one or more roles under a logo (`company` variant).

TimelineRole.description: A single role/position within a company entry (`company` variant).
